metadata.scope: Every web/app/**/page.tsx, including route groups, parallel slots, redirects and placeholders. Tests and stories excluded from normative evidence.

path_aliases.component-package/src/: reference shared UI component workspace; package identity intentionally neutralized
path_aliases.reference-application: neutral substitution in rare source-specific branded filename or identifier; same line numbers and surrounding directory structure retained

app_owned_exceptions: Tapstate app shell and global navigation
limitations: Static source study only. No browser screenshots or interaction verification.
Import expansion follows syntactically rendered components to depth four; it does not assert exhaustive transitive dependency coverage.
Evidence lines are literal constructs; a matching permission identifier or error field is not proof of a fully implemented permission/error flow.
Legacy and newer surfaces coexist; frequency does not make either a required target default.
No source was copied into product repositories, installed, tested, built, published, or mutated.

validation.family_code_evidence: All 36 family code blocks regenerated from route/selected-primary rule evidence; non-access agent family blocks contain no access-policy dispatcher branch.

resolved_dispatch_edges.runtime_limit: Ordinary versus workflow logs depends on runtime resource mode; child evidence remains only possible dependency.
Ordinary versus workflow logs depends on runtime resource mode; child evidence remains only possible dependency.

reachability_revision.page_evidence_boundary: Only route and selected immediate implementation. Deeper imported snippets are possible dependencies, not page-state evidence.

parallel-slot.title: Parallel detail-sidebar slots
parallel-slot.rule: Keep detail navigation in a named shell slot and render the same resource-aware sidebar across child routes; creation routes may deliberately clear that slot.
parallel-slot.caveat: This describes navigation ownership only. Preserve the Tapstate app shell, navigation, and logo. A null slot is intentional absence, not an empty-state design.

home.title: Workspace home
home.rule: Compose home from a stable shell, independently hydrated content, and a shell-matched skeleton; use task or recommendation sections rather than inventing a dashboard of unrelated metrics.
home.caveat: Recommendations and promotional banners are product-specific. Preserve app-owned shell, accents, and liquid-glass surfaces.

agent-list.title: Agent collection
agent-list.rule: Use a compact title and help row, a separate filter toolbar, and one bounded scroll region for the collection; adapt visible help copy to a labelled icon on narrow screens.
agent-list.caveat: Copy list and loading composition only when the target has equivalent collection behavior; do not copy resource branding or domain actions.

agent-configure.title: Agent configuration workspace
agent-configure.rule: Scope editor state to the selected resource and compose editing plus auxiliary panels inside the detail shell.
agent-configure.caveat: Editor sessions, AI generation, publishing, and panel semantics are product contracts rather than primitive library defaults.

agent-access.title: Agent access surfaces
agent-access.rule: Separate access delivery cards from permission-policy editing; use a persistent section heading and bounded content width, and expose failed fetch recovery in place.
agent-access.caveat: Access entry points and permission policy must follow Tapstate authorization; disabled UI is not backend authorization.

agent-logs.title: Agent logs
agent-logs.rule: Place explanation above wrapping query controls, retain a bounded results area, open a selected record in a responsive detail drawer, and keep pagination separate from the table.
agent-logs.caveat: The source uses mobile-dependent backdrop and pagination behavior. Browser verification is required before adopting breakpoints or focus-return assumptions.

agent-monitoring.title: Agent monitoring
agent-monitoring.rule: Group time/source controls above a responsive metric chart grid, preserve chart-shaped placeholders, and place retry near the failed metric section.
agent-monitoring.caveat: Metric selection, chart type, tracing, and time-window defaults are product-specific; do not invent target metrics.

app-editor.title: Application and snippet editors
app-editor.rule: Let an editor own its full available canvas and horizontal overflow; isolate resource-keyed state and supply domain contexts before rendering the workspace.
app-editor.caveat: Canvas topology, workflow behavior, and code generation are outside UI reuse. Keep central translator/dispatcher contracts intact.

app-access.title: Application delivery and policy
app-access.rule: Use a compact heading/description above environment tabs or deployment tables; keep access-policy forms bounded and split environment selection from scrollable content.
app-access.caveat: Deployment and access actions require existing product permissions and contracts. This research does not authorize deployment or copying product pages.

app-observability.title: Application overview, logs and annotations
app-observability.rule: Keep route wrappers thin; pass the resource identifier and explicit display mode into shared observability surfaces, and match suspense placeholders to the eventual form or table shape.
app-observability.caveat: A shared implementation does not make logs and annotations interchangeable. Placeholder existence is not proof every fetch failure has recovery.

knowledge-list.title: Knowledge collection
knowledge-list.rule: Distinguish first-use empty state from filtered-empty results, announce state transitions, and gate creation/external configuration with workspace permissions.
knowledge-list.caveat: Legacy and new knowledge views coexist behind availability state; neither is a universal component standard.

knowledge-create.title: Knowledge creation and connectors
knowledge-create.rule: Give multistep ingestion a full-height panel with a stable header and bounded body; keep authentication/source loading distinct from editable steps.
knowledge-create.caveat: Ingestion steps, connectors, and templates are domain workflows. Do not impose them on Tapstate tasks without a corresponding product brief.

knowledge-documents.title: Legacy document management
knowledge-documents.rule: Keep document list header and controls outside its growing content region; separate loading, nonempty results, and actionable first-use empty state. In detail views use a resource header plus content and metadata panes.
knowledge-documents.caveat: Responsive detail drawers and document parsing state are implementation-specific. A placeholder API route is not normative UI evidence.

knowledge-retrieval.title: Retrieval testing
knowledge-retrieval.rule: Compose query/history and result regions as a task pair, announce query state, and move secondary detail into a drawer where space is constrained.
knowledge-retrieval.caveat: Search/ranking semantics and result metadata are domain-specific. Legacy and new versions use different layouts.

knowledge-settings.title: Knowledge settings
knowledge-settings.rule: Use a heading plus concise description, constrained form width, role-based text colors, and visible load-error recovery; preserve label and section geometry in loading skeletons.
knowledge-settings.caveat: Danger zones must follow actual authorization and confirmation requirements; no source styling implies the same destructive action belongs in the target.

knowledge-pipeline.title: Knowledge pipeline canvas
knowledge-pipeline.rule: Give the pipeline the full task workspace and explicitly allow horizontal canvas overflow.
knowledge-pipeline.caveat: This only establishes container behavior; pipeline nodes, processors, persistence, and validation remain product-owned.

new-knowledge-overview.title: New knowledge overview
new-knowledge-overview.rule: Order a knowledge workspace from status/readiness and onboarding to metrics, attention/outcomes, activity, and inventory, while exposing recovery without replacing all settled content.
new-knowledge-overview.caveat: Use only sections supported by target data. Source-specific readiness and task-sync orchestration are not generic library features.

new-knowledge-documents.title: New document management
new-knowledge-documents.rule: Keep task, permission, and model runtime recovery as explicit controllers around a results surface; mount processing-task and metadata drawers beside that surface.
new-knowledge-documents.caveat: Controller ownership and permission recovery are application architecture, not styling primitives. No browser recovery behavior was exercised.

new-knowledge-sources.title: New source management
new-knowledge-sources.rule: Use title/help, readiness guidance, explicit loading/error/empty branches, then search/filter/sort and selectable rows; present retry in the failed region.
new-knowledge-sources.caveat: Only expose import/create actions allowed by the real permission model. Do not turn loading into an empty state.

new-knowledge-quality.title: Knowledge quality
new-knowledge-quality.rule: Use a titled tab workspace with tab-local action slots, mount the active analysis panel, and preserve a separate report state when drilling into results.
new-knowledge-quality.caveat: Evaluation concepts and report routing are source-domain behavior. Tabs must use target-supported state and accessible semantics.

marketplace.title: Marketplace, templates and creators
marketplace.rule: Host browse content inside a dedicated scrollable surface with permission-provider ownership; keep filter/selection state in canonical URLs and validate public query parameters.
marketplace.caveat: Third-party discovery, install permissions, creator profiles, and branding are domain-specific. Reuse container and state separation only.

integrations.title: Integration management
integrations.rule: Use a contextual sidebar and section renderer on wide screens, replacing sidebar access with a titled drawer on narrow screens; wrap long labels and preserve focused disclosure affordances.
integrations.caveat: The Tapstate global navigation remains app-owned. This contextual sidebar is evidence for task-local navigation, not permission to replace the shell.

skills.title: Skill collection and detail
skills.rule: Build management collections with a separate toolbar, card-shaped skeletons, explicit initial/refresh/pagination errors, accessible card actions, and guarded destructive dialogs.
skills.caveat: Archive upload, tag management, resource naming confirmation, and reference dependency checks are product behavior. The reference has two UI generations; do not copy its branding.

snippet-list.title: Snippet collection
snippet-list.rule: Use breadcrumbs for nested studio collections, a wrapping filter/search/action toolbar, state announcements, initial retry, and incremental card skeletons.
snippet-list.caveat: A nested collection may need breadcrumbs; a top-level destination may not. Search/result semantics remain target-owned.

installed.title: Installed application runtime
installed.rule: Keep runtime-specific errors, access denial, and initial loading distinct inside a framed application surface.
installed.caveat: Runtime framing and access handling depend on target context; do not copy the source shell, logo, accent, or deployment contracts.

share-runtime.title: Shared and embedded runtimes
share-runtime.rule: Authenticate and fetch access/configuration before rendering chat or text-generation content; preserve dynamic viewport height, safe-area space, and explicit unavailable states.
share-runtime.caveat: Embedded and standalone runtimes differ. The source access boundary includes source-specific messages and redirects; adapt, never transplant them.

human-input.title: Human input form
human-input.rule: Treat a public action form as a state machine: loading, unavailable or expired, already completed, and the loaded actionable form must be separate surfaces.
human-input.caveat: Token validity and submission behavior are application security and workflow contracts; styling reuse cannot define them.

auth.title: Authentication and recovery
auth.rule: Use a narrow, responsive form column with heading/explanation, labelled fields, field-local errors, pending submit feedback, and a clear secondary return action. Verification-code inputs declare numeric mode and one-time-code completion.
auth.caveat: Source auth policy, anti-bot, SSO, password rules, and token query handling must not be copied into target contracts. Source errors sometimes only reach console logging; do not normalize that gap.

device-auth.title: Device authorization
device-auth.rule: Render explicit authorization stages and distinct success, invalid-code, rate-limit, lookup-failure, and SSO-error surfaces; give each a next action near its message.
device-auth.caveat: Device flow endpoints, retry rules, URL scrubbing, and account switching are security behavior and require a target contract.

oauth-consent.title: OAuth consent
oauth-consent.rule: Show the requesting application, active account with switch action, requested scopes, and a visually clear authorize/return decision; retain initial loading and error surfaces.
oauth-consent.caveat: Consent is a security decision: scope semantics, redirects, and silent authorization remain application-owned. Source-branded accent is not reusable.

account.title: Account profile
account.rule: Group identity summary, editable account fields, security settings, and account deletion into separate sections, with edits handled in focused dialogs.
account.caveat: Premium/education banners and account deletion policy are source-specific. This does not authorize adding target account capabilities.

education.title: Eligibility verification
education.rule: Separate verification/loading/retry/rejection/success states, then route a valid application token into a dedicated form under a simple task shell.
education.caveat: Eligibility, billing, and policy copy are source-specific. Reuse state hierarchy only.

unavailable.title: Unavailable document
unavailable.rule: Make denial/unavailability independently renderable with localized document metadata, a readable explanation, useful identifiers, and optional locale/theme controls.
unavailable.caveat: Do not copy branding or exposable diagnostic details blindly. Backend error semantics and disclosure policy remain target-owned.

redirect.title: Canonicalization and transition routes
redirect.rule: Canonicalize obsolete or incomplete routes before rendering; validate route/query state and preserve meaningful selection in the canonical destination.
redirect.caveat: These routes are behavior evidence, not page layouts. Do not invent a UI for a deliberate redirect.

placeholder.title: Unfinished route
placeholder.rule: Treat a literal placeholder as an inventory exception, never as a reusable composition or quality standard.
placeholder.caveat: The implementation is a single text div; no finished interaction, state, accessibility, or responsive standard can be inferred.

app-list.title: Application collection
app-list.rule: Compose the application collection from a dedicated list surface and explicit creation/import dialogs; gate mutations with workspace permissions and direct initial dialog focus to the resource-name input.
app-list.caveat: Application metadata, template import, onboarding, and creation tracking are source-domain behavior. Preserve the target app shell, accents, liquid-glass surfaces, and actual product capabilities.
